description: This file defines the EvidenceService class responsible for managing audit-linked JSON evidence packages, including creation, retrieval, integrity verification, and linking to approval records. It interacts with a database and filesystem for storing artifacts and manifests.

classes.name: EvidenceError
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling evidence-related errors.

classes.name: EvidenceService
classes.description: Service class providing methods for creating, retrieving, and linking evidence packages.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_evidence_package( self, submission_id: str, package_id: str, package_version: str, evidence_items: List[Dict[str, Any]], actor_user_id: str = "system", actor_role: str = "system", correlation_id: str = "", )
methods.description: Creates a new evidence package with artifacts and manifest, and records audit events.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_evidence_package(self, evidence_package_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves an evidence package by ID, validates integrity, and returns its details.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_evidence_artifact(self, artifact_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves an artifact by ID, validates hash, and returns its content.

methods.name: None link_evidence_to_approval( self, evidence_package_id: str, approval_record_id: str, actor_user_id: str, actor_role: str, correlation_id: str, )
methods.description: Creates an audit linkage between an evidence package and an approval record.
